description_zh: 该接口用于查看SQL日志运行报告列表
name: DescribeSQLLogReportList

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ* format. The time must be in UTC.**

>  The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 > 必须大于查询开始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

*   **30**
*   **50**
*   **100**

Default value: **30**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Valid values: any **non-zero** positive integer.

Default value: **1**
parameters.help_zh:
页码。大于**0**，且不超过Integer类型的最大值。

默认值：**1**
parameters.name: page_number
